name: Wolf Pack
_note: R31.2: first clear gives a Tower Shield

name: Trouble on the River
desc: A fisherman's skiff has fouled the Millbrook weir. Clear it and he gives you the little boat. With a boat you can fish deep water for bigger catches, and trips can cut across lakes. A clear weir also means more fish (+50% from Fish).
tip: With a boat you can fish deep water for bigger catches (pick Deep or Auto under Fish), and trips can cut across lakes. No Dock needed.

name: A Letter Sealed in Wax
desc: A courier brings a letter bearing a crest you have never seen.

name: The Miller's Debt
desc: The miller knew your grandmother. He owes her a favor.

name: Smoke Over the Ridge
desc: Raiders burn a homestead; the widow deeds you her plot.

name: The Hidden Ledger
desc: A rumor of a ledger naming your lost house. Hear it in the tavern.

name: Into the Old Forest
desc: The ledger points to a ranger lodge deep in the trees.

name: The Dryad's Price
desc: The dryad will speak of House Vael, for a price.

name: Ashes of House Vael
desc: The ruined manor of your ancestors. Its banner still hangs.

name: The Treant's Oath
desc: The old treant returns the acre it guarded for your bloodline.

name: The Usurper's Hand
desc: House Crane, the usurper's house, sends agents to hunt your family. Find them through rumors.

name: Reclaim the Name
desc: Face the usurper, Lord of House Crane, and restore House Vael.

name: The Old Well
desc: Something glints at the bottom.

name: The Lost Heir's Locket
desc: A peddler sells a locket with your family crest.

name: Hermit's Cache
desc: A buried chest of a long-dead hermit.

name: Moonlit Duel
desc: A masked duelist challenges the strongest of your house.

name: The Sunken Chapel
desc: A drowned chapel holds an old smith's plans.

name: The Eyrie Oath
desc: The eagle-riders swear friendship to a house that climbs to them.

name: Bring in the Ashbrook Harvest
desc: Help House Ashbrook's fields before the rain.

name: Audit the Tallow Ledgers
desc: Count candles and coin for House Tallow.

name: Outbid Ashbrook at Market
desc: Buy up the grain contract House Ashbrook wanted.

name: Drive Off Poachers
desc: Clear poachers from House Vey's woods.

name: Sabotage the Corran Charcoal
desc: Ruin House Corran's charcoal stacks in the Old Wood.

name: Escort Corran Ore Carts
desc: Guard House Corran's ore on the road.

name: Poach Marlowe's Bargemen
desc: Lure skilled hands away from House Marlowe.

name: Recover Marlowe Cargo
desc: Fish a sunken barge's cargo out of the river.

name: Undercut Tallow's Candle Trade
desc: Flood the market so House Tallow's prices collapse.

name: Carry Skye's Sealed Letters
desc: Deliver letters no one else may read.

name: Spread Rumours of House Vey
desc: Whisper about House Vey's debts in the right halls.

name: Raid House Ashbrook's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Ashbrook where it hurts.

name: Raid House Tallow's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Tallow where it hurts.

name: Raid House Vey's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Vey where it hurts.

name: Raid House Marlowe's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Marlowe where it hurts.

name: Raid House Corran's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Corran where it hurts.

name: Raid House Skye's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Skye where it hurts.

name: The Baron's Charter
desc: The Baron will charter a village on your Valley for 25,000 coin, 300 stone blocks and 200 planks, delivered in person.

name: Haul for Bram
desc: Bram needs 10 wood carted to his yard. He lends you his old handcart for the job and tells you to keep it: with a cart, every gathering trip brings home far more than you can carry on your back.

name: A Merchant's First Run
desc: A Thornwick trader wants 20 wheat. Wheat is cheap in Millbrook (it grows there) and dear in Thornwick: buy it at Millbrook's market, haul it here, and sell. That's trade: buy where it's made, sell where it's wanted. Pull it off and the trader sells you her old wagon and shows you how one is built.

name: The Old Pike of Mirrormere
desc: Old Tam swears a monster pike haunts the deep water of Mirrormere. Take your boat out and land it, and the cook will show you her Pike Pie.

name: Survey the Commons
desc: Pace out and chart Millbrook's commons for the guild (a masonry and reading check).

name: The Leaning Granary
desc: Shore up a farmer's granary before it falls: bring blocks and planks.

name: Raise the Chapel Roof
desc: Millbrook's church needs new roof beams raised before winter.

name: The Old Keep Survey
desc: Survey the ruined Vael manor in the highlands: what stands, what can be saved.

name: Gulls in the Nets
desc: Gulls are tearing the drying nets. Shoo them off and mend what's torn.

name: Crab Pots
desc: Haul the old crab pots off the north rocks before the tide.

name: Lantern Watch
desc: Keep the cape lantern lit through a stormy night, far up the coast.

name: Salvage the Skiff
desc: A skiff broke loose and grounded far down the coast. Bring back what you can.

name: Storm Mooring
desc: A gale is coming. Double the moorings on the fishing fleet.

name: Tar the Hulls
desc: Help the fisherfolk patch and tar their hulls on the hard.

name: Lights on the Rocks

unlock.text: Odile reopens the harbour ferry for your family

desc: Act 1 side beat (after chapter 2): wreckers show false lights on the rocks to lure ships ashore. Catch them, and the harbour can sail again.

name: Mend the Ashbrook Fences
desc: House Ashbrook's thread “The Long Harvest”, part 1 of 3.

name: Seed Grain for a Hard Year
desc: House Ashbrook's thread “The Long Harvest”, part 2 of 3.

name: The Long Harvest
desc: House Ashbrook's thread “The Long Harvest”, part 3 of 3.

name: Count the Old Oaks
desc: House Vey's thread “The Wood Remembers”, part 1 of 3.

name: The Bark-Blight
desc: House Vey's thread “The Wood Remembers”, part 2 of 3.

name: The Wood Remembers
desc: House Vey's thread “The Wood Remembers”, part 3 of 3.

name: Caulk the Barges
desc: House Marlowe's thread “Marlowe's Barges”, part 1 of 3.

name: River Pirates
desc: House Marlowe's thread “Marlowe's Barges”, part 2 of 3.

name: The Salt Contract
desc: House Marlowe's thread “Marlowe's Barges”, part 3 of 3.

name: Feathers for the Eyrie
desc: House Skye's thread “The Eyrie Oath”, part 2 of 3.

name: An Oath Kept
desc: House Skye's thread “The Eyrie Oath”, part 3 of 3.

name: Mark the Wreck
desc: House Corwen's thread “Salvage Rights”, part 1 of 3.

name: Raise the Strongbox
desc: House Corwen's thread “Salvage Rights”, part 2 of 3.

name: Salvage Rights
desc: House Corwen's thread “Salvage Rights”, part 3 of 3.

name: Tallow's Little Favour
desc: House Tallow's thread “Tallow's Bargain”, part 1 of 3.

name: Short Weights
desc: A crooked deal: thumb the scales on Tallow's grain sales. Profitable, and House Tallow remembers who helped.

name: Tallow's Bargain
desc: Tallow's big bargain: corner the grain contract out from under House Ashbrook.

name: Coal for the Corran Forges
desc: House Corran's thread “Corran's Forge Rights”, part 1 of 3.

name: Guild Strongarm
desc: House Corran's thread “Corran's Forge Rights”, part 2 of 3.

name: Corran's Forge Rights
desc: Pick a side: force House Sallow's last forge out of Ashford for House Corran.

name: Polish the Chapel Bells
desc: House Dawnward's thread “Bells of Dawn”, part 1 of 3.

name: The Alms Road
desc: House Dawnward's thread “Bells of Dawn”, part 2 of 3.

name: Bells of Dawn
desc: House Dawnward's thread “Bells of Dawn”, part 3 of 3.

name: Catalogue the Stacks
desc: House Ormond's thread “The Ormond Library”, part 1 of 3.

name: A Book Gone Missing
desc: House Ormond's thread “The Ormond Library”, part 2 of 3.

name: The Ormond Library
desc: House Ormond's thread “The Ormond Library”, part 3 of 3.

name: Sallow's Old Letters
desc: House Sallow's thread “Old Debts”, part 1 of 3.

name: Debts Remembered
desc: Pick a side: help House Sallow call in an old debt from House Corran.

name: Old Debts
desc: Ruin House Corran's standing with the debts Sallow kept.

name: Raid House Corwen's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Corwen where it hurts.

name: Raid House Dawnward's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Dawnward where it hurts.

name: Raid House Ormond's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Ormond where it hurts.

name: Raid House Sallow's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Sallow where it hurts.

name: Sea Raiders at the Pans
desc: Raiders row in at dusk to steal salt. Drive them back to their boat.

name: The Beached Whale
desc: A whale has come ashore south of the pans. Help cut it up before it spoils (and before the Lodge claims it).

name: Lighthouse Supplies
desc: The old lighthouse keeper needs timber and rope before the winter storms.

name: Rake the Salt Pans
desc: Hask is short of hands at the Great Salt Pans.

name: Kelp Harvest
desc: Cut kelp at low water before the tide comes back in.

name: Lost in the Fog
desc: A fishing boat never came home in the fog. Find it before dark.

name: The Pearl Divers' Rope
desc: Hold the line for the pearl divers off the Tidal Pools.

name: Eel Nest in the Sluice
desc: Giant eels have nested in the sluice gates of the salt works.

name: Escort the Salt Tithe
desc: The salt tithe goes inland under guard. The Lodge's men walk with it and say nothing all the way.

name: Amber in the Dunes
desc: A storm has uncovered amber in the dunes. Get there before the dune-pickers do.

name: The Drowned Bell
desc: Act 2 beat (after chapter 4): a sunken chapel bell rings at low tide. Raise it, and learn why the chapel was drowned.

name: Vael's Smugglers
desc: Act 2 beat (after chapter 6): House Vael's own goods once moved through Saltmere's smugglers. Someone in the Grotto still keeps the old manifests, and they lead to chapter 7.

name: Old Tobiah's Stories
desc: “What the Reef Keeps”, 1 of 4: buy Old Tobiah a few ales and let him talk about the reef.

name: Lights on Blackwater Reef
desc: 2 of 4: sail out at night and watch the lights on Blackwater Reef (Sailing or Scouting check; needs your own Sea Boat).

name: The Lodge's Ledger
desc: 3 of 4: get a look at the Lodge's ledger (Etiquette or Thievery check). Gold comes in from the reef; fish and “guests” go out.

name: Low Tide on the Reef
desc: 4 of 4: wade the reef at the lowest tide. Carved stones, a sealed sea-cave mouth, and then the tide turns. What you do with what you saw is up to you.

choice.title: What the Reef Keeps
choice.text: You saw the carved stones and the sealed cave. The sea-cave stays sealed either way.

options.name: Keep the secret
options.text: House Gilmane's standing rises and reef-gold gets cheaper for you.

options.name: Tell the Church
options.text: Healers' Guild rep rises and House Gilmane turns Cold.

name: Quiet Cargo
desc: House Gilmane's thread “The Gilmane Ledger”, part 1 of 3: carry sealed crates and ask nothing.

name: Salt for the Lodge
desc: Part 2 of 3: the Lodge wants salt, delivered at night.

name: The Gilmane Ledger
desc: Part 3 of 3: recover a page of the Gilmane ledger before the Church does.

name: Raid House Gilmane's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: hit House Gilmane where it hurts.

name: Goat-Path Rescue
desc: A goatherd's boy is stuck on a ledge above the goat-path. Get him down before the weather turns.

name: Strays on the Ridge
desc: The Eyrie's mountain rams broke out of the Highland Pasture in a storm. Round them up off the ridge.

name: Heather Honey
desc: The wild hives in the high heather are full. The Eyrie's mead hall pays well for the honey.

name: Avalanche Pass
desc: Snow and rock have buried the high pass. Dig it out and shore it up before the traders give up on it.

name: Frost Wolves
desc: A pack of white wolves has come down from the snowline and is taking the Eyrie's goats.

name: The Eagle-Riders' Trial
desc: The eagle-riders test anyone who swore the Eyrie Oath: a climb to the nests and a shot from the cliff edge (Archery or Leadership check). Nobody rides an eagle yet, but they'll know your name.

name: The Giant's Cairn
desc: The hill giants pile their dead under a great cairn and guard it. Someone has been robbing it, and the giants blame the valley.

name: Stormcrest Shrine
desc: An old shrine on the Stormcrest, struck by lightning every spring. Relight its lamps and see who has been leaving offerings.

name: The Usurper's Dwarven Steel
desc: Act 3 beat (after chapter 8): House Crane has been buying dwarven blades through the Eyrie. Follow the mule trains up the mountain and learn who is selling, and why the usurper wants dwarven steel.

name: A Stranger at the Gate
desc: “The Rune-Sealed Gate”, 1 of 9: Gatewarden Thrain Ironbrow sets his terms. Prove you are useful, and that you can keep your mouth shut.

name: Bread and Barley
desc: 2 of 9: the clans under the mountain grow little. Bring bread and barley to the post.

name: Silver for the Seal
desc: 3 of 9: silver ore and stone to repair the gate. Thrain trusts you with the first piece of the Ironbrow Clan-Crown, lost for generations: the Crown-Band.

name: Wolves on the Traders' Path
desc: 4 of 9: a frost-wolf pack is harrying the dwarven traders on the path to the post. Clear it.

name: Ale for the Watch
desc: 5 of 9: the gate garrison is dry. Your own Brewery's ale, or a town's, will do.

name: Raiders in Stormhold Depths
desc: 6 of 9: raiders are using Stormhold Depths to slip past the gate. Drive them out, and recover the second piece of the Clan-Crown they stole: the Brow-Stone.

name: A Matter of Discretion
desc: 7 of 9: you have learned where the gate's weak rune lies. House Crane's agents would pay well for it.

choice.title: A Matter of Discretion
choice.text: The usurper wants dwarven steel and a way under the mountain. Thrain will know what you chose.

options.name: Keep the secret
options.text: Thrain trusts you: dwarven steel and ingots cost 10% less at the gate post and in Dwarfhold.

boon.text: Steel and ingots −10% at the gate and Dwarfhold (you kept the secret)

options.name: Sell it to House Crane
options.text: 1,200 coin. Thrain finds out: Clan Ironbrow starts Cold.

name: Tools and Tribute
desc: 8 of 9: iron for tools, charcoal and a gift of gold for the Thane. In return, the last piece of the Clan-Crown: the Crest.

name: The Rune-Sealed Gate
desc: Act 3 beat (after chapter 8), 9 of 9: Thrain vouches for you. Reassemble the Ironbrow Clan-Crown (Band, Brow-Stone and Crest) before the gate, and the dwarves open it for its bearer. The Rune Road leads down into Dwarfhold.

name: Bread for the Deep Halls
desc: Clan Ironbrow's thread “Oath of the Thane”, part 1 of 3: the deep halls are hungry. Feed them.

name: The Ancestor Stones
desc: Part 2 of 3: raise the fallen ancestor stones in the Old Deeps' upper halls, under guard.

name: Oath of the Thane
desc: Act 3 beat (after chapter 9), part 3 of 3: the Thane pledges Clan Ironbrow to your family before the Clan-Crown. Dwarfhold favour rises, two more dwarves may serve you, the War-Chariot plans are yours, and the clan will stand with you when you reclaim your name (+10% in chapter 10).

name: Raid Clan Ironbrow's Stores
desc: Only while feuding: the dwarves will not forget it.

name: Too Much Gold
desc: “The Gilded Hall”, 1 of 5: the investigation. Count what Saltmere sells against what its pans and boats could ever bring in. The numbers do not add up: far too much gold.

name: The Wide-Eyed Folk
desc: 2 of 5: ale for Tobiah, fish for Widow Kelda, and quiet questions. The missing are not dead, Kelda whispers: they “went down to Father”. Father Dagon. The church on the hill has a name now.

name: Inside the Gilded Hall
desc: 3 of 5: attend a service (Etiquette) or slip in at night (Thievery). Gold on every pillar; sea things carved over the walls and altar; above it, a sign of wrong angles that hurts to look at. They sing to Father Dagon, and, softer, to Mother Hydra.

name: The Gold's Mint
desc: 4 of 5: past the Smugglers' Grotto's Sea Gate (needs your own Sea Boat), an underwater treasury where reef-gold is worked into strange shapes. A carved map shows a tunnel running inland, under the mountains, to a round door: the Deep Door under Dwarfhold.

name: The Old Bargain

choice.title: The Old Bargain
choice.text: You know where the gold comes from. The Lodge knows that you know.

options.name: Expose the Order
options.text: The Church and the Crown hear everything. Healers' Guild rep and renown rise; the Lodge and House Gilmane turn to feud, and Saltmere prices rise for two years.

options.name: Join the Order
options.text: Take the oath. The Lodge becomes your ally: reef-gold −20% and +25% fishing, and children may be born Sea-touched. The Church turns away, and some years one of your family will go down to Father.

options.name: Strike a bargain
options.text: 2,000 coin now and 200 every season, and the Lodge leaves you alone: Neutral standing, and a first cache of 10 reef-gold. Miss a payment and they turn Cold again.

desc: 5 of 5: the choice. Expose the Order, join it, or strike a bargain. Whatever you choose, the Deep Door will remember.

name: Raid the Lodge's Gold
desc: Only while feuding: strip a little gold from the Gilded Hall.

name: Mother's Pool: The Audience
desc: Behind the Deep Door, a black pool. She does not rise; her voice comes up through the water. She knows your family, and she is pleased. Mother Hydra blesses you: +15% fishing, and reef-gold sells for 10% more everywhere. She will call her children home a little more often.

name: Mother's Pool: The Trial of Tides
desc: She rises halfway and asks three things of you: faith (Faith or Focus), the sea (Sailing or Fishing) and courtesy (Etiquette or Haggling). Pass two and she gives you a Tide-Pearl. Fail and she sends you back up, bruised, to try again in a month.

name: Mother Hydra
desc: The pool boils. Mother Hydra rises, vast and many-eyed, and she remembers what you did to her children. Win, and her scale is yours. Lose three times and the sea floods the Old Deeps for a season.
